⚡ Quick scan: one tap, a ready PDF.

📐 Frame: fit the sheet into the A4 frame on the screen.
🎯 Auto: the camera finds the edges of the sheet itself and straightens it.
⚠️ If the sheet does not fit, the frame and the outline turn red and the app warns you: move the phone away.
📷 The photo is taken at the camera's maximum quality. The image quality in the PDF is set in Settings.
💾 When saving you choose: Recognize and save (the PDF gets searchable text), or Save as is.

%1$s

📷 Scan: pick what you shoot and tap Shoot. The item is put on an A4 sheet at real size.

✨ Full auto: no size to pick. When the sheet is seen whole and the phone is still, the camera shoots by itself. The page is put on the A4 sheet, its shape kept.
📐 Frame: fit the item into the frame of the chosen size.
🎯 Auto: the camera finds the edges of the item itself and straightens it. Hold a card horizontally, a receipt vertically.
💳 Card: licence, residence permit, ID, bank card; both sides go on one sheet.
🧾 Receipt: a long strip can be continued with the next part.
⚠️ If the item does not fit, the frame turns red and the app warns you.
💾 When saving you choose: Recognize and save, or Save as is.

%1$s
